reviewScope: Read-only source review of frozen V3 strict source.go delta; no edits, parser, compiler, tests, native calls or runtime reproduction.

findings.observation: Strict decoder only special-cases 1/s and otherwise parses bytes as plain protobuf. Original MarshalChange emits only empty datatype or 1/s. A different tag with valid protobuf is not refused.
findings.recommendation: Add strict-only supported datatype admission for exactly the original emitted tags. Preserve ordinary reader behavior.

findings.observation: Strict validation covers snapshot Details/Collections and block identities, but not block.Fields. Original State.Validate checks child graph only. Snapshot and created blocks pass simple.New without field validation; BlockSetFields assigns its value without field validation. A malformed unused block field can coexist with matching schema details.
findings.recommendation: Use existing pbtypes.ValidateStruct for snapshot block.Fields, created block.Fields, and BlockSetFields event Fields in the strict precheck. A shared strict block check should refuse nil/empty IDs before simple.New can synthesize an ID, retaining original default behavior.

confirmed: Existing unmarshalChange and BuildState callers select strict=false; exact 11 source replacements plus addition reconstruct the frozen candidate.
Strict Snappy DecodedLen/Decode failures return before protobuf; protobuf decoding failures propagate.
Strict replay uses error-returning original State.ApplyChange and returns State.Validate errors; no default-state application is enabled.

The observer separately runs UnmarshalChangeStrict on every persisted non-root record before BuildStateStrict, including snapshots older than the common snapshot; later snapshot data is not exempt merely because current replay uses ChangeNoSnapshot.
Snapshot metadata validation runs before NewDocFromSnapshot's removal/normalization of invalid details.
notReviewed: all unrelated body field or block-type validators
qualification: V3 strict source should not be qualified until the two concrete strict-admission gaps are resolved and the selected new controls execute. No broader compiler/native acceptance is asserted.
